guidances.citation: The Company now expects its full-year 2026 reported diluted EPS to be in the range of $8.04 to $8.49, and its adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $9.25 to $9.70.
The Company now expects its full-year 2026 reported diluted EPS to be in the range of $8.04 to $8.49, and its adjusted diluted EPS to be in the range of $9.25 to $9.70.
Food & Industrial Ingredients–U.S./CAN operating income is now expected to be down 35-40%, driven by operating costs at Argo
All Other’s operating loss is still anticipated to be approximately $(15) million, which reflects the absence of a second half earnings contribution from the sale of the Pakistan business.
For full-year 2026, the Company expects a reported effective tax rate of 27.9% to 28.9% and expects an adjusted effective tax rate of 26.5% to 27.5%.
